profile.headline: Senior Frontend Engineer | React, Typescript, Angular | Building tools for regulated industries
profile.summary:
Angular by trade, React by choice. Interested in regulated domains, complicated data, and interfaces that make hard things feel easy.

I work both sides of the frontend: the design layer - information hierarchy, sensible defaults, screens that don't make people think harder than the task requires  and the architecture underneath it, built the way enterprise applications have to be built. Modular structure, typed contracts, predictable state, reusable component systems, tests that survive the original authors.
 
I'm not frontend-only. I've written endpoints in .NET and queries in SQL against the same platform, so I design interfaces knowing what the database has to do to serve them. On my own stack I work in Node, React, and Vite end to end.
 
Which is what I'm building now - an underpayment detection engine for dental practices. It reads explanation of benefits data, compares it against contracted fee schedules, and finds revenue that quietly never got collected. Designed, architected, and built it myself, front to back.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Ramping into the platform's transition from Angular to React/Vite
positions.insights: Skills: Angular · React.js · Next.js · Prisma ORM · .NET

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Frontend development on an all-in-one security compliance platform used by defense contractors and government facility security officers to manage cleared personnel, classified material, and contract security obligations.
 
• Built the front end for the program management system covering personnel security clearances, visitor access control, classified document accountability, foreign travel, and foreign contact reporting
 
• Lead development of large-scale enterprise modules in Angular (v15+) and .NET Core, owning architecture decisions across the platform's core screens
 
• Architected a configuration-driven user interface system and JSON-based rule engine, so new screens and business rules ship as configuration rather than code

• Developed complex data-entry and reporting interfaces in Angular and TypeScript against strict audit and compliance requirements, where a wrong record is a compliance finding rather than a bug
 
• Built dynamic form systems and AG Grid data views over 10000-record datasets, using server-side pagination, filtering, and virtualization to keep large views responsive
 
• Designed a reusable component library adopted across 10+ modules, cutting duplicate implementations and standardizing form, grid, and validation behavior platform-wide
 
• Wrote .NET Core endpoints and SQL queries backing these features - designing interfaces with full knowledge of the query cost behind them

positions.title: Frontend Web Developer II
positions.description: Designed and implemented the front-end architecture of a prescription management web app using Angular, integrating with .NET Core RESTful APIs. Developed reusable UI components, applied state management best practices, and optimized load performance. Worked closely with backend developers to define API contracts and ensure consistent data exchange. Contributed to UI/UX improvements, accessibility compliance, and responsive design for both desktop and mobile users.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
Making all applications predictable and consistent, making progression natural, making constraints purposeful, making Interactivity visible, provide continuous feedback, match the user’s mode of operation, reduce performance load, and assumed nothing on what a user can or cannot do.
Meticulously evaluate and applied better UI/UX in rebuilding a MVC .NET C# application content management system for 1800Recycling.com a website for managing recycled materials, drop-off locations, and etc. It is the industry leading search engine for recycling drop-off location and solutions. 
Used SCSS (Latest CSS pre-processor) and applied 7-1 pattern, making the interface thought as little components. In result of short amount of CSS needed for the whole project, also much easier to maintain than a chaotic mess where everything is flustered.
Applied expertise to make the system look consistent and behave intuitively and easy to use. Collaborated with team to make sure the front end and view model works with controller and model. 
Followed Agile Development. Maintained, enhanced and applied expertise on each project task for TrachTech (Company tracking management system) and MyTrackTech (Client’s tracking management system). 
Each project task made sure that the interactivity should corroborate and reinforce the content so it helps the user to understand the content. Used Stored Procedures, ASP.NET MVC, ADO.NET, VB.NET, SQL Server Reporting System, and MS SQL for tasks in legacy systems that require more features.
Connect to Remote Windows Servers and IIS
Used Angular 2 with Typescript to enhance the performance on the front-end side

positions.title: Front End Engineer (.Net)
positions.description:
• Developed front end for Navigator Program (A program of Covered California) and purposely optimized for desired User Experience with elegant new User Interface features.
• Developing a cross platform mobile application that helps on-field staff of San Diego Gas and Electric specifically on Energy Savings Assistance program.
• Optimized the front end of SMJU’s customer relationship management website with rich User Interface and User Experience. 
• Developed an animated Energy Savings Calculator using Snap SVG 
• Created graphics and wireframes for Covered California programs such as IPAS, GPAS and CPAS
• Used HTML5, CSS3, Javascript, Bootstrap UI framework, Ionic UI framework, Persistence JS, Angular JS, Phonegap, Telerik Kendo UI, Snap SVG, Icenium App Builder, .NET C#, Visual Studio and other Microsoft tools.
